definitions.explanation: Describes explaining, describing, or examining something with meticulous attention to every detail, leaving nothing out.

examples.japanese: {事細|ことこま}かに{説明|せつめい}する。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{旅行|りょこう}の{様子|ようす}を{事細|ことこま}かに{話|はな}してくれた。
examples.english: She told me about the trip in great detail.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}には{事故|じこ}の{経緯|けいい}が{事細|ことこま}かに{記|しる}されていた。
examples.english: The report described the circumstances of the accident in minute detail.

notes:
A somewhat literary adverb that emphasizes thoroughness and completeness in describing or explaining something. The underlying な-adjective {事細|ことこま}か can also be used attributively ({事細|ことこま}かな{説明|せつめい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事細|ことこま}かに{説明|せつめい}する: to explain in detail
- {事細|ことこま}かに{報告|ほうこく}する: to report in detail
- {事細|ことこま}かに{記録|きろく}する: to record in detail
- {事細|ことこま}かに{尋|たず}ねる: to ask in detail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {詳|くわ}しく: in detail — the most common, everyday way to say this
- {細|こま}かく: in detail, finely — focuses on small divisions or precision
- {逐一|ちくいち}: one by one, point by point — emphasizes going through each item individually
